contributions.name: Yoraiz0r / FF7RebirthDataObjectEditor

contributions.name: Synthlight / FF7R2-DataObject-Parser
contributions.role: CC BY-NC 4.0 Rebirth format documentation used to independently verify IoStore-state DataObject layout and public table/row/property names across PlayerParameter and the unresolved Rebirth gameplay areas. Lexeditor does not vendor or adapt this implementation.

contributions.name: trumank / retoc
contributions.role: MIT-licensed IoStore CLI reviewed as the pinned DirectoryIndex extraction route. It is not automatically invoked because its Oodle dependency may be acquired when absent.

contributions.name: matyamod / UnrealReZen (ff7r branch)
contributions.role: GPL-3.0 FF7R2 packaging reference used to verify UE4.26, End/Content mounting and the Rebirth dependency-manifest workaround. Lexeditor can invoke only a separately supplied local executable through its candidate-only packaging route; no UnrealReZen code or binary is bundled.

contributions.name: nikolaybutnik / FFVII-Rebirth-Mesh-Patcher
contributions.role: MIT-licensed public Rebirth tooling used to cross-check that native IoStore mod triples are discovered under End/Content/Paks/~mods. No code is vendored or adapted.

contributions.name: Gantz79 / 100 Percent Steal and Drop Rate
contributions.role: Public Rebirth behavior evidence for #471: a packaged rate edit works and the author reports the 25% rate data is shared between steals and enemy drops. Used for semantic boundary research only; no mod assets are copied or redistributed.

contributions.name: TheWolfster / Refreshed Chocobo Rest Stops (Static Mesh)
contributions.role: Public Rebirth evidence for #472 that Chocobo rest-stop meshes can be replaced and that the blue bench is a separate asset among multiple bench models. Used for research only; no mod assets are copied or redistributed.

contributions.name: DaniRBT / FF7 Rebirth Accessibility - Visibility Overhaul
contributions.role: Public Rebirth evidence for #473 separating pak-based minimap position/size changes from the optional UE4SS HUD mover. Used to avoid conflating HUD layout with world-minimap zoom; no mod assets are copied or redistributed.
